english.title: Non motor vehicle fail to stop at red light at pelican crossing
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[rider]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY NON-MOTOR VEHICLE..), failed to comply with the vehicular light signal at a Pelican crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) which was displaying a red light
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 23 of the Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTE
The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, these regulations may still be used for offences relating to Pelican crossings; this is providing the Pelican crossings were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal), by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.
